description.value: A working vineyard and lavender farm in the Cowichan Valley, producing cool-climate varietals with winemaker Dylan Sheldon and operating under the Cobble Hill Winery brand. Visitors are welcomed for guided tastings in the tasting room and are encouraged to bring a picnic to enjoy on the garden patio overlooking the vineyard and lavender fields. The scenic rural setting and patio make it a memorable stop for cyclists touring the Cowichan Valley.

address.value: 3500 Telegraph Rd, Cobble Hill, BC V8H 0E1

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at cobblehillwinery.ca is clearly for 'Cobble Hill Winery,' not 'Damali Wine & Lavender Farm' as named in the OSM record — a significant name mismatch that is flagged below. The website confirms an active, publicly accessible winery at 3500 Telegraph Rd, Cobble Hill, BC with a tasting room, garden patio, and lavender fields, consistent with the lavender-farm theme in the OSM name. No cycling-specific amenities (bike parking, water, washrooms, Wi-Fi, etc.) are mentioned anywhere on the website.
concerns: Name mismatch: OSM record is 'Damali Wine & Lavender Farm' but the provided URL leads to 'Cobble Hill Winery' — these may be the same property under a rebrand or two distinct businesses; manual_id 'cobble-hill-food-drink-damali-wine-lavender-farm' suggests they are treated as the same, but this should be verified.

OSM community field lists 'Sidney' but the website address is Cobble Hill, BC — these are distinct communities roughly 15 km apart; the coordinates (48.686, -123.554) are geographically closer to Cobble Hill than Sidney, suggesting an OSM community assignment error.
No OSM tags are present for this record, so no contact details could be cross-referenced against the website.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active, publicly accessible winery with a tasting room and garden patio open to walk-in visitors; a legitimate and appealing stop for touring cyclists on Cowichan Valley routes.
